title: Turning Point For All Nations
textType: Statement or commentary issued by a Bahá’í institution
author: bahai-international-community
attributionNote: Turning Point For All Nations, by the Bahá’í International Community: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its Official Statements and Commentaries shelf.
description: A Statement of the Bahá’í International Community on the Occasion of the 50th Anniversary of the United Nations. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (Official Statements and Commentaries).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
